title: sokf new report
description: `NewResult` is the report of `sokf new --json`: it holds the document that the command builds. The command prints the document but does not write it (CLI-6_AC-12).

path.description: `path` is the path at which `--write` writes the document. An asset is a file of the knowledge that is not Markdown, such as an image, and a sidecar is the document that describes an asset. `--write` writes a sidecar beside its asset. It writes any other document as `<id>.md`, either in the directory that the schema gives the document's lifecycle states or in the directory set by `--dir`.

document.description: `document` is the whole text of the document.

RepoPath.description: A path relative to the repository root, which starts with `/` and uses forward slashes. The path `/` is the root itself.
